_policy: See .github/scripts/advisory_gate.py. Critical findings cannot be excepted. Each exception needs owner, approved_by, rationale, compensating_controls, status APPROVED and an expiry no more than 180 days ahead. Entries below are PROPOSED drafts: they are NOT valid until a named owner approves them, so the dependency-audit job fails until then.

exceptions.rationale: postcss is a nested dependency of next@15.5.27; the patched postcss requires next@16 (major upgrade, separate decision). The advisories need attacker-controlled CSS or source maps to be processed by postcss.
exceptions.compensating_controls: CSS is compiled only at build time from repository sources (no user-supplied CSS or source maps); the production web image runs next start on a read-only filesystem as a non-root user; upgrade to next@16 tracked as a separate approved workstream.

exceptions.rationale: Build-time only: pulled in by tailwindcss@3 (chokidar/micromatch). The fix requires tailwindcss@4 (major upgrade, separate decision). Not present in the production image's runtime dependencies.
exceptions.compensating_controls: Glob patterns come from the repository's own Tailwind configuration, not from users; the build runs in CI and in a throwaway Docker build stage.

exceptions.rationale: Test-time only (requirements-dev.txt); not installed in the production API image. The fix is pytest 9.0.3, a major upgrade that must be checked against pytest-asyncio.
exceptions.compensating_controls: The issue needs another local user on the same UNIX host (/tmp/pytest-of-<user>); CI runs on single-tenant ephemeral runners and local tests run in throwaway containers.
